setup.task: 5-token sequence-like XOR reconstruction; four decoder-like blocks, each with separately optional local-attention and MLP suboperations
setup.suboperations: A0,M0,A1,M1,A2,M2,A3,M3; attention and MLP each count as one work unit
setup.hard_cap: maximum active suboperation count, structurally enforced by controller selection
setup.soft_price: controller is post-trained from exact finite-mask task-loss + price*active_ops/8 frontier
setup.training_boundary: capability network trained across random suboperation masks; controller amortized afterward; not end-to-end sparse training
setup.timing_boundary: ordinary Linux/PyTorch batch-1 central timing; not WCET

interpretation.supported: In this supplied decoder-like toy, a hard work cap plus scalar resource price changes which attention and MLP suboperations are physically executed; across all three seeds MLP computation is reduced before attention depth is reduced, showing composition adaptation beyond prefix-depth selection.
interpretation.negative_boundary: Seed 2 has weaker full capability (~84.8%), and controller-to-exact-loss-oracle agreement is 24/27 rather than perfect. The result is mechanism evidence, not an optimal subgraph-discovery claim.
